provenance.E_c: Constant-guess rule approved on PR #3 (replaces v1 E_c = 0.30). One constant, 38.7015 C, = person-balanced mean +15-minute target over 175 development windows from the 11 people in no keep_going task; E_c = that constant's person-balanced MAE on the same windows, 0.1712 C. A forecast as bad as the constant guess on average earns zero forecast credit on average. Formula unchanged: max(0, 1 - err/E_c). Source: tasks/calibrate_forecast_e.py -> docs/forecast_e_calibration.json frozen_E_c.
provenance.ectemp_B: Per-person baseline MAE: tasks/beat_ectemp/ectemp_baseline.py (via template.py as submission.py) through benchmark.evaluate(hidden=True), person_mae over scored requests (all requests after the first watts drop). Workbook MD5 01214bfc835215fe1a5d3f5da1e9ad52. Two hidden runs per variant with independent random time offsets gave identical values; the baseline never reads time_min. Only H06 and H13 of the five test people ever have a watts drop, so only they have scored requests (3A: 36 + 21, 3B: 51 + 36).
provenance.required_cases: 12 scored keep_going cases (KG-03 edge case excluded), RB-01, RB-02, and the 4 per-person Beat ECTemp cases that have scored requests.
